groups.sentence: Administrators evaluate and track the impact of AI on student learning and outcomes through rigorous, continuous assessment.
Administrators survey or poll students and faculty about their AI use, concerns and needs to inform policy.
Academic misconduct and honor code cases involving generative AI have increased.
Research on the effects of AI on learning is still early and many universities have no policy yet.
Instructors regularly assess the impact of AI use in their courses on learning outcomes and skills, and adjust based on student feedback.
Surveys report how many students use generative AI tools and how often.
Research shows AI use can harm learning, including reduced critical thinking, cognitive debt and overreliance.
Research shows structured, intentional AI use can support learning and produce equal or better outcomes.
